description: Fishbone (Ishikawa) Cause Analysis — AI Ishikawa / fishbone cause-and-effect analysis. Picks category sets by domain (software: Code, Infrastructure, Process, People, Tools, Requirements, Monitoring; manufacturing: 6M Methods, Machines, Materials, Measurements, Environment, People; service: Policies, Procedures, People, Place, Systems, Customers) - auto-detected or domain=. Each cause has sub-causes, likelihood 1-5 and a quick check; returns the top 5 causes to check first, empty categories, data to collect and a markdown diagram. Param problem=, optional context=, domain=. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

problem.description: e.g. API p95 latency doubled after the October release
